title: Transit Destination Inference from Tap-In-Only Bus Smart-Card Data: A Hierarchical Bayesian Approach
abstract: arXiv:2608.11223v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Entry-only automatic fare collection systems record boardings but not alightings, preventing direct construction of origin-destination (OD) matrices. This study develops a Hierarchical Bayesian Latent-Destination (HBLD) model that combines station-hour boarding and inferred alighting demand with passenger card histories. Trip-chain destinations are treated as noisy evidence with a reliability parameter, allowing destination uncertainty to propagate into OD flows. The model was applied to 838,305 bus tap-ins collected in Changzhou in May 2025 and linked to stop-network and hourly weather data. It estimates destination distributions over feasible downstream and reverse-direction through-terminal stops using network, time-of-day, weather, and smoothed historical demand effects. translated_title: 仅刷卡公交智能卡数据中的目的地推断：一种分层贝叶斯方法
translated_abstract: 仅入口自动收费系统记录上车但不下车信息，阻碍了直接构建起讫点（OD）矩阵。本研究开发了一种分层贝叶斯潜在目的地（HBLD）模型，该模型结合了站点小时上车和推断下车需求以及乘客卡历史记录。链式出行目的地被视为带有可靠性参数的噪声证据，使目的地不确定性传播到OD流量中。该模型应用于2025年5月常州收集的838,305次公交刷卡数据，并与站点网络和小时天气数据相关联。它利用网络、时段、天气和平滑历史需求效应，估计可行下游和反向终点站的目的地分布。贝叶斯个性化层使用先前的卡出行记录，并在历史不可用时回退到共享的出行级分布。通过随机变分推断进行拟合。
tldr: 本研究提出一种分层贝叶斯模型，仅利用公交刷卡上车数据推断乘客目的地，并有效处理目的地不确定性，从而构建准确的OD矩阵。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a hierarchical Bayesian model to infer passenger destinations from tap-in-only bus smart-card data, effectively handling destination uncertainty to construct accurate OD matrices.
